items.title: FOI documents reveal how Anika Wells' New York trip costs escalated
items.description: The final New York travel bill for Communications Minister Anika Wells and her staffer rose $7,000 from an initial booking due to last-minute changes.

items.title: Living costs rise for all but those on government payments hit hardest
items.description: Cost-of-living pressures are being felt by all households, but some have been hit harder than others as annual costs increased between 2.3 and 4.2 per cent in 2025, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

items.title: Australian man Michael 'Micky' Hurst dies in Japan while skiing
items.description: The 27-year-old was at the rear of a group of skiers in Japan's Hokkaido region, between Niseko Moiwa Ski Resort and Niseko Annupuri International Ski Resort, when he had a medical episode.

items.title: 'That's terrifying': Fake AFP set found in Cambodian scam compound
items.description: A fake AFP office staged by scammers who operated from a Cambodian scam centre reveals much about their tactics, experts say.

items.title: Trump leaves 'door wide open' to nuclear arms race
items.description: The last remaining nuclear arms pact between the United States and Russia has come to an end at a time of global instability.

items.title: 'Unbelievable sadness': Melinda Gates reacts to claims against ex-husband
items.description: Melinda French Gates says her ex-husband, Bill Gates, needs to answer for his behaviour alleged in the latest batch of Epstein files.

items.title: Ex-prince Andrew leaves Windsor home after latest Epstein revelations
items.description: British police are investigating Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor after new files suggest Jeffrey Epstein arranged for a woman to have sex with the former prince at his home at the Royal Lodge in 2010.

items.title: Labor MP 'uncomfortable' with Israeli president's visit
items.description: Labor's Ed Husic says it is "hard to reconcile" a visit by Israeli President Isaac Herzog with comments he has made in relation to the war in Gaza.

items.title: The Rafah Crossing has reopened but why are most Gazans still trapped?
items.description: Only five patients, along with their family members, exited through Rafah on the first day of its reopening, according to ABC staff inside Gaza. Doctors say it does not scratch the surface of the thousands of Palestinians who desperately need medical evacuation.

items.title: Hundreds of NT residents to be evacuated ahead of 14 metre flooding levels
items.description: About 450 people are being evacuated from the remote Northern Territory town of Daly River, ahead of expected flood levels of more than 14 metres.

items.title: Austin Appelbee's incredible tale of survival has made international headlines
items.description: Austin Appelbee, 13, has made international headlines after swimming for four hours in rough seas to save his mum, sister and brother stranded in the ocean. How did he do it?

items.title: Magistrate says 'depraved' child sex abuse material worst she's ever seen
items.description: Sydney man Colin Milne has been denied bail after "extremely graphic, violent and depraved" material was found on his devices, a court has heard.

items.title: Liberals say $15b fund backing 'loser' green projects will fuel inflation
items.description: The $15 billion fund will be allowed to back riskier green projects under new rules announced today.

items.title: World's fastest animal spotted in Central Australian outback for first time
items.description: The world's fastest falcon has been spotted in Central Australia for the first time, surprising even the seasoned birdwatcher who caught the rare sight on camera.

items.title: Government to sell historic defence properties
items.description: The Albanese government has identified 67 defence sites for potential sale, aiming to unlock up to $1.8 billion.

items.title: Ley stands by demand to exile Nats rebels amid talks on Coalition split
items.description: The Nationals leader has refused to disclose whether he will reject an offering for the Coalition to reunite with a list of conditions, including a six-month suspension from the frontbench for three Nationals senators.

items.title: Women on taking a break from their marriage
items.description: Do you ever feel like taking a break from your marriage? Three women share how a marriage sabbatical changed their relationship.

items.title: Mum wrangles crocodile lurking in puddle outside NT bottle shop
items.description: Melody Wehipeihana was dropping her kids off at school when she pulled over to see what a crowd had gathered to look at in a puddle outside a Northern Territory pub.

items.title: Husband of woman who vanished in 1986 'wrote fake confession to coroner'
items.description: Raymond Reddington failed to report his wife missing for several days, changed his story multiple times and wrote a fake confession letter to the state coroner, a Perth court hears.

items.title: 'Shattered hearts': Piper James's family joins traditional owners in smoking ceremony
items.description: K'gari traditional owners have held a smoking ceremony for Piper James, who died on the island last month, to give her spirit a safe passage home.

items.title: Mother 'sick to her gut' as search called off for missing son
items.description: Zjaequaan Sebasio's family and WA Police are urging anyone with information about his location to come forward, after his disappearance almost a week ago.

items.title: Harbour bridge e-bike stunt could have 'ended in many deaths'
items.description: Police are combing over CCTV of Tuesday's stunt where officers believe several offences were committed.

items.title: Escort's disappearance 'not taken seriously', sister tells inquest
items.description: An inquest has wrapped up into the disappearance of Sydney escort Revelle Balmain, 31 years after she was reported missing.

items.title: How an 'honest mistake' upended tennis player's Australia Open dream
items.description: Thomas Fancutt has made his return to professional tennis after receiving a 10-month ban for a vitamin and magnesium infusion.

items.title: No plans to increase security at Wittenoom after blogger's 'devastating' visit
items.description: Asbestos disease advocates criticise a Queensland blogger for taking her daughter to one of Australia's most contaminated sites.
